annotations.title: Connect a running site and get its verify command

description: Store key: call when the site is served from a process that keeps running (background, fixed port) and menu items show at that origin. Use http://localhost:<port>, not 127.0.0.1: the sandbox key allows only localhost. Returns whether the origin is allowed, a runId and the exact verify command; run it as returned while the site runs. Sign-in and every check after it WAIT until the sandbox guest exists: report them, never stub sign-in. If originAllowed is false, read kit_docs_get topic onboarding. Each call starts a new run; use the latest runId. Example: {"storefrontKey":"pk_test_…","origin":"http://localhost:5173"}.

origin.description: The site's origin or full URL, for example http://localhost:4321 or https://test.okam.no/sandbox/. A path in it goes into the verify command's --url.

path.description: Optional path the site is served under, for example /sandbox/, when origin has none.

storefrontKey.description: The site's publishable storefront key (pk_test_… or pk_live_…).

name: storefront_connect
title: Connect a running site and get its verify command
